releaseSummary: The **Is Lab** contact tag now enables Stock Lenses and Lab Supplies when it is assigned to the portal person, parent company, customer-linked contact, or CRM company resolved to that customer account.
An open portal rechecks this permission when the pricelist page is revisited or the browser regains focus.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Portal Lab Pricelist Tag Resolution.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
